name: Bay St. Louis Beachfront RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 400 m frame) at 30.2487,-89.4240: herringbone of RV pads on the inland side of South Beach Blvd; across the road a ~100 m sand beach to the Mississippi Sound - an open view of the water, but no pad at the waterline; bayview

name: Hollywood Casino Tunica RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 34.8117,-90.4179: paved RV rows south of the casino hotel in open farmland; a small pond lies north of the hotel, away from the sites; not waterfront

name: Wolf River RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 30.3775,-89.2231: wooded RV loops south of the Wolf River's marsh edge with a small pond among them; the operator claims 'some waterfront views' but no pad is visible at the riverbank under canopy (default down); not waterfront

name: Go Fish RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 31.7938,-89.0214: RV rows beside a fishing pond next to aquaculture ponds; the rows sit above the pond but the image can't confirm pads at the waterline (default down); not waterfront

name: Leaf River RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 31.2177,-88.9914: a gravel RV row in pine woods; the Leaf River is out of sight to the north-east; not waterfront

name: Seminary Canoe Rental & RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 31.5150,-89.4610: RV sites in a wooded clearing 100-150 m east of Okatoma Creek, with forest between them and the water; 'steps from the water' is marketing; not waterfront

name: Huckleberry Hills RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 34.8214,-88.2269: a gravel RV lot in pine woods; no water; not waterfront

name: Hidden Cove RV Park (Moss Point)
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 30.4535,-88.5501: RV rows along a gravel lane in woods; a bayou channel with the boat launch runs along the north edge behind a road and trees, so no pad is confirmed at the waterline (default down); not waterfront
